title: SMS: Regional Director — "Three Things Before the 10:15 CMT Call"

bubbles.text: Alberto Matsinhe, Camille Laurent and I need three things before the CMT call at 10:15. 1) When and how does Nhamissa restart? 2) What goes in Flash Update No. 2? 3) What is the 48–72 h plan and the funding ask?
The donor press office has emailed Geneva again. Their draft still says '3,000 kits'. I don't want the Minister quoting a number we can't stand behind.

Also on the CMT log. OCHA IM sent this at 09:40, their Sitrep 2 draft for partner check by 11:00: 'HRI: 600 households reached with hygiene kits and jerrycans at Nhamissa; 3,000 shelter kits available, Beira.' Is that our line? Who is correcting it?

Your base radio log shows Nhamissa site management at 09:46: 'Calm now. Police have closed gate 2. The committee proposes restarting tomorrow at 07:00 with family tokens, two lines, women and older people first, and a complaints desk. Will HRI agree?' That's your call, but I need the answer and the time for 10:15.

instructorNote: This is the end-game consolidation. Watch whether the CD agrees to a phased Nhamissa restart with the committee's measures and SFP clearance. Also watch whether the IMO corrects OCHA's draft by 11:00 to show 212 households reached (212 hygiene kits, 424 jerrycans) with 388 kits held, and stock as Recount 1 and sheet v3 instead of 3,000 kits, with MSKU 448210-3 shown as held. The CD should present the 48–72 h plan under HRI plan section 4. The CMT chair decides the internal fund release, and no public funding figure goes out before that approval.
